description: Make a wallet the venue's payout wallet for this principal (S1 step 4). A name or email join registers the principal under the deck's house wallet, and the venue pays withdrawals ONLY to the principal's operator wallet — so until this step a venue withdrawal cannot reach the person. Call without arguments for the exact message to sign (EIP-191 personal_sign, valid 10 minutes) and its signed_at; then call again with wallet_hex, signed_at and signature_hex. The identity door recovers the signer itself; refused when the signature is stale or foreign, when another principal already operates under that wallet, when the wallet's key is public, or when the principal is registered on chain. When the payout wallet is already a person's (the first call says must_sign and current_wallet), that current wallet signs the SAME message too and you pass it as current_signature_hex; a lost wallet is reset by support. Behind the second factor.

current_signature_hex.description: the CURRENT payout wallet's EIP-191 signature over the same message, when must_sign said so

signature_hex.description: the wallet's EIP-191 signature over the message, 0x + 130 hex

signed_at.description: the unix seconds the message carries (from the first call)

wallet_hex.description: the wallet to make the payout wallet, 0x + 40 hex

name: operator_link
